Per me teper informacion ose per ta pare nga afer me kontakto!
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale on Elbasan Street!
description_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, on Elbasani Street! We offer for sale a 3+1+2 apartment in Rr. Elbasani, near the Faculty of Foreign Languages. The apartment has a surface area of ​​117 m2 net and 129 m2 gross. It is located on the 1st residential floor of a relatively new, well-maintained and managed building. It is organized by the entrance corridor, the living room together with the kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The apartment is newly invested by the current owner and has investments that are worth mentioning, chiller system, ac5 parquet, double glazed windows, incaso furniture, new quality electrical appliances. For more information or to see it up close, contact me!
